correctness.rationale: The underlying Gaussian covariance and antipodal endpoint identity follow directly from standard Brownian covariance. Conditioning on W(1)=z and integrating the correctly normalized killed transition density over z yields the exact spectral CDF, with eigenvalues k^2*pi^2/(8h^2) and integrated factor 2*(-1)^(k+1). Poisson theta transformation gives the positive image tail; Tonelli justifies every positive real moment. Unique Brownian extrema plus the absolutely continuous joint min/max/endpoint density exclude an absolute tie; signed circular translations preserve the exact covariance, yielding independent Haar maximizing time. The archived standalone checker was executed from its actual final path and passed 61,766 exact-arithmetic and numerical assertions, including covariance, signed rotations, theta duality, eigenmode integrals, moments and tails. Finite checks support constants but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The newly catalogued nonlocal anti-periodic Brownian boundary process has a canonical full-path confinement event and peak location. Its all-threshold exact CDF, positive-real moment family with zeta values and independent uniform maximizing point provide a complete, explicitly usable excursion height/location law, beyond covariance, small-ball asymptotics or an arbitrary parameter slice. Such constants calibrate supremum events for this process and clarify the effect of opposite tied endpoints. Heat-kernel and Haar tools are classical; the mathematically motivated combined identification in this exact process is the claimed contribution.
